_why: Operations removed from the backend contract before the mobile client is generated. Every entry names why and which task removes it. Nothing is excluded silently: scripts/api/sync_contract.py prints this list on every run.

tags.why: The mobile app never calls admin endpoints.
Admin controllers whose tag ends in Admin (AbroadAdmin, FxAdmin, ReferralAdmin, SchoolSettlementAdmin, WaitlistAdmin, WorldAdmin) are for the dashboard, never the app.
Ops endpoints are for staff tooling, not the app.
Provider callbacks, never called by a client.
